summary: Smart host filters query cached facts via /api/v2/hosts?host_filter=..., supporting () grouping, and/or, __ for related fields and JSON paths, [] for arrays and quoted values, for example ansible_facts__ansible_processor_vcpus=8 or groups.name:groupA.
questions: How do I filter hosts by Ansible facts in the API?
How do I find hosts with 8 vCPUs in controller?
How do I search hosts by group name?

answer_card.title: host_filter examples
answer_card.answer_md:
Filter hosts by name, group or cached facts (needs fact caching on the job template):

```
/api/v2/hosts/?host_filter=name=localhost
/api/v2/hosts/?host_filter=ansible_facts__ansible_processor_vcpus=8
/api/v2/hosts/?host_filter=ansible_facts__ansible_processor[]="GenuineIntel"
/api/v2/hosts/?host_filter=(name=localhost or name=database) and groups__name=east
```

`__` separates related fields and JSON keys, `[]` marks an array, quotes allow spaces. In UI search use `groups.name:groupA` or `ansible_facts.ansible_fips:false`.
